item.title: ✖️ Chris Perruna $ELF $118 after hours. Holding shares Q2 Fiscal 2027 Earnings H
item.description:
✖️ Chris Perruna

$ELF $118 after hours.

Holding shares

Q2 Fiscal 2027 Earnings Highlights (Reported Nov 4, 2026)

• Net Sales: Rose 51% year-over-year to $520.8 million, marking the company's 31st consecutive quarter of net sales growth.
• Adjusted EPS: Came in at $1.21, easily beating Wall Street consensus estimates.
• Adjusted EBITDA: Reached $123.4 million (up 86% YoY).
• Growth Drivers: Broad-based momentum across its portfolio (including e.l.f. Cosmetics, Naturium, and Rhode), strong international and retail/e-commerce expansion, and TikTok Shop performance.

Raised Full-Year 2027 Guidance

• Net Sales: Increased to a range of $2.00 billion to $2.03 billion (22% to 24% growth).
• Adjusted EPS: Raised to $3.82 to $3.86 per share.
• Adjusted EBITDA: Raised to $421 million to $427 million.
